review_scope: Independent exact final-output source review; public development Android emulator evidence, not generated-answer, holdout, legal or physical-device acceptance.
verification: All25 final quote texts match reviewed exact spans and UTF16 display slices; titles, revision URLs/dates, contributor histories and citation ID suffixes match; six warned spans absent; five selected manifest-bound output/transport/image files verify; restart g01 text unchanged. All24 baseline rendered strings are byte-identical to prior run. Recorded metadata hashes retained, not reconstructed from omitted collectionProvenance.

g01.question: How does photosynthesis convert light energy into chemical energy?
g01.rationale: Light absorption, water splitting, ATP/NADPH and storage in organic bonds are covered by complete scoped paragraphs; baseline contains the same two paragraphs.

g02.question: How do chlorophyll pigments and light-dependent reactions produce oxygen?
g02.rationale: Pigment locations and water/electron oxygen-production conditions are explicit; Calvin-cycle paragraph adds context; baseline also adds a tangential solar-cell paragraph but covers the obligation.

g03.question: What do ATP and NADPH do in the Calvin cycle?
g03.rationale: Calvin-cycle paragraph states ATP/NADPH reduce compounds for carbohydrate production and retains organism scope; baseline alone contains that sufficient paragraph.

g04.question: How does cellular respiration transfer energy from nutrients to ATP?
g04.rationale: No quotation supplies nutrient-to-ATP transfer; excluded disputed respiration source stays excluded; baseline likewise withholds.

g05.question: Compare aerobic and anaerobic cellular respiration with fermentation.
g05.rationale: No aerobic/anaerobic/fermentation comparison is provided; source exclusion is respected; baseline also incomplete.

g06.question: Why are respiration reactions catabolic?
g06.rationale: Catabolic breakdown and controlled release are unanswered; source exclusion is respected; baseline also incomplete.

g07.question: How does inflation reduce purchasing power?
g07.rationale: General-price rise and reduced goods per currency unit are explicit; broader effects are extra context; baseline is equally sufficient.

g08.question: What is the difference between inflation and deflation?
g08.rationale: Admitted Inflation paragraph1 explicitly contrasts inflation and deflation, but both outputs withhold over unmatched differenc; source availability does not count as delivered usefulness.

g09.question: What factors can change inflation?
g09.rationale: Money supply, demand, supply, interest rates and expectations are preserved without monocausal assertion; baseline covers the same factors.

g10.question: How does longitude specify an east-west position?
g10.rationale: East-west angular coordinate, prime meridian and positive/negative signs are covered; baseline adds time context but is also complete.

g11.question: Why does a difference of 15 degrees longitude correspond to one hour?
g11.rationale: Earth rotation, solar position and fifteen-degree/one-hour local-time relation are explicit, without civil-time-zone generalization; baseline also complete.

g12.question: What distinguishes longitude from latitude?
g12.rationale: Admitted longitude paragraphs1 and3 contain the distinction but no quotations are delivered because distinguish is unmatched; both outputs fail completeness.

g13.question: What is an algorithm and why must it terminate?
g13.rationale: Finite termination is explicitly definitional with computing-problem scope; neither output claims arbitrary programs terminate; baseline paragraph1 is sufficient.

g14.question: How do randomized algorithms use inputs?
g14.rationale: Random input versus deterministic transitions is explicit; baseline has the same relevant paragraph without the additional definition.

g15.question: What does habeas corpus determine about detention?
g15.rationale: Court review of detention lawfulness is explicit, with historical suspension context; no individual legal result is asserted; baseline also complete.

g16.question: What limitations can apply to habeas corpus during a state of emergency?
g16.rationale: Admitted Habeas corpus paragraph2 explicitly supplies some-country emergency suspensions, but apply blocks both outputs; unanswered despite available source.

g17.question: How do convection and subduction contribute to plate motion?
g17.rationale: Density-driven mantle convection, ridge cooling and subduction are explained with disputed-factor caveat retained; baseline is complete but adds irrelevant core-magnetism text.

g18.question: How do solar modules produce direct current from sunlight?
g18.rationale: Direct current is an electrical noun, not a current-status request; both outputs falsely classify CURRENT and withhold the admitted cells/modules/arrays/inverter paragraph.

g19.question: How do printing presses transfer ink?
g19.rationale: No pressure/ink-transfer explanation is delivered; excluded AI-warning printing source stays excluded; baseline also incomplete.

g20.question: How does photosynthesis store chemical energy?; How does cellular respiration transfer energy to ATP?
g20.rationale: Photosynthesis storage is covered, with tangential historical magnitude context, but respiration-to-ATP subquestion is withheld; baseline supplies neither obligation.

g21.question: What is longitude?; What is an algorithm?
g21.rationale: Longitude opening paragraph now defines east-west angular position, prime meridian and signs; Algorithm opening paragraph defines finite instructions; independent subquestions are both covered without inferred cross-topic relation; baseline still has no quotes.

g22.question: What is the current inflation rate today?
g22.rationale: Correctly withholds unsupported live inflation rate with zero quotes in both outputs; abstention success is separate from a complete useful source brief.

g23.question: What does my detention record say?
g23.rationale: Correctly withholds unavailable personal detention record with zero quotes in both outputs; no source-brief success credit.

g24.question: When will the next earthquake occur?; Explain quuxzorbium antimatter cultivation.
g24.rationale: Both future earthquake and invented-topic obligations are explicitly unanswered without quotes; baseline withholds the whole request under prediction scope; correct abstention is not source-brief completeness.

critic_sentence: Continue: twelve of twenty-four public-development briefs now satisfy the frozen usefulness threshold versus eleven baseline briefs, with supported quotations and correct absence controls; remaining omissions and false current-status rejection persist.

comparison.qualification: This measured source-brief threshold was reached after a declared post-result change on the same public development cases; it is not fresh holdout evidence or competitive superiority.

source_diff_review.finding: The ten-line sourceResearch addition compares nonempty sets of generic rankTerms(question) and rankTerms(title), selects first eligible passage per URL in passage order, and boosts it to10000; no case IDs, named topics or source-specific rules occur in the addition.
source_diff_review.limits: Applied only when disk==null; this run does not establish equivalent disk-backed behavior. Normalized term-set equality is not literal title-string equality. The synthetic score can influence downstream relative relevance thresholds; no broader robustness claim follows.

visual_review.finding: Captured focused reader displays Photosynthesis title, Offline snapshot label, Close reader and Reading options, followed by readable opening selected paragraph at enlarged type; viewport continues below its bottom without horizontal clipping.
visual_review.limit: Screenshot shows only the first viewport, not the full paragraph or lower attribution panel; machine-bound output/source evidence supplies the complete text. Emulator screenshot is not physical-device acceptance.

normalization.operation: List of cases keyed by unchanged id; no assessment changes
